fullDescription: MedsZap is a clean, modern healthtech and pharmaceutical delivery design system characterized by a refreshing teal and blue palette (#1ABC9C, #3498DB). It features a highly responsive layout that transitions seamlessly from mobile-first single columns to sophisticated desktop bento-style grids. The typography uses the Satoshi font family for an editorial yet accessible feel, with specific responsive scaling from 18px to 32px for headings. Key visual markers include rounded iconography, subtle hover-triggered gradient overlays, and a heavy emphasis on 48px touch targets. Ideal for healthcare marketplaces, wellness platforms, fintech, or any service-oriented SaaS requiring a trustworthy and clinical-yet-friendly aesthetic.

structured.summary: A clinical and user-friendly responsive design system utilizing a teal primary brand color, high-contrast typography, and depth-inducing hover states. It prioritizes accessible touch targets and optimized layouts across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports using a strict rem-based spacing system.

style.description: The style is 'Modern Clinical,' utilizing the Satoshi typeface (Weights: 400, 500, 700, 900) and a palette of #1ABC9C (Teal) and #3498DB (Blue). Interactive elements use a cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) transition for professional smoothness. Visual depth is achieved through subtle border-radius (rounded-xl/2xl) and soft shadows (rgba(0,0,0,0.05)) that intensify on hover.
style.prompt: Create a design system with a primary color of #1ABC9C and secondary #3498DB. Use 'Satoshi' sans-serif as the primary font. Body text should be #1C1C1C for high readability. Implement a strict spacing system based on 1rem=16px. Component borders should be 1px solid #F3F4F6 with a border-radius of 0.75rem (12px) for small cards and 1rem (16px) for larger sections. Interactive elements must have a 300ms transition using cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Hover states for cards should include a subtle Y-axis lift (-0.25rem) and a shadow increase to 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08). Buttons must maintain a minimum touch target of 48x48px on mobile and 44x44px on desktop. Use smooth scrolling throughout with scroll-behavior: smooth.

layout_and_structure.description: A tiered layout system that adapts container widths from full-width mobile to a 1280px (7xl) desktop constraint. It uses a vertical stack of content blocks including a sticky header, category grids, brand carousels, and pharmacy listings.

prompts.prompt: Height: 56px (mobile), 64px (tablet), 72px (desktop). Background: #FFFFFF with a bottom border #F3F4F6. Mobile layout: Logo on left, Hamburger menu (24px icon) on right, with a separate full-width search bar row below (height 44px, background #F9FAFB). Desktop layout: Logo on left, a centered max-w-2xl search bar including a location selector (separated by a 1px vertical line), and 'Log in/Sign up' links on the right.

Grid structure: 2 columns (mobile), 3 columns (tablet), 5 columns (desktop). Each card: height 90px (mobile) to 112px (desktop). Elements: A 40px-48px circular icon background (varying soft pastels like #FEF2F2, #EFF6FF) containing a 24px-32px icon, followed by font-semibold text (13px-15px) with line-clamp-2 for longer titles. Gaps: 0.75rem (mobile) to 1.5rem (desktop).

Grid structure: 1 column (mobile), 2 columns (tablet), 3 columns (desktop). Each card is a container with 12px padding. Featured image: 16:9 aspect ratio with object-cover and 12px border-radius. Include absolute positioned badges: Top-left for discounts (Teal background, white text, 10px bold), Bottom-right for delivery time (White blur background, 11px bold). Content below image: H3 title (16px-18px), a sub-text line for categories, and a footer row with distance (left) and a 'Visit' CTA (right, #1ABC9C).

Background: #F9FAFB. Structure: Logo at top-left/center, followed by a 4-column grid (MedsZap, Services, Partners, Legal). Headings: 11px uppercase bold with tracking-widest. Links: 13px #4B5563 with #1ABC9C hover color. Bottom section: Copyright text (11px) on left, social icons (LinkedIn, Instagram, Twitter) in #9CA3AF on the right.

special_ui_components.description: A complex card component with an image-mask hover effect.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a card where the image container has an absolute positioned div named 'hover-gradient-overlay'. This overlay is a linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(26,188,156,0.08) 0%, transparent 100%). It should have opacity: 0 and transition to opacity: 1 over 300ms when the parent card is hovered. The image itself should scale by 1.05 on hover without breaking the container bounds (overflow: hidden).

special_ui_components.description: A dual-input search bar that consolidates location and keyword search.
special_ui_components.prompt: Design a search component with height 48px. Left side: Location selector (Icon + text) with a fixed width of 180px on desktop. Right side: Text input with search icon. The two halves are separated by a 1px solid #E5E7EB divider. On mobile, the location selector is removed, and the bar becomes a single 44px high input with background #F9FAFB.
